让拾光，按你的习惯陪伴。: A little companion, just your way.
登录 Windows 后，自动显示桌面工作球。: Show the orb when you sign in to Windows.
同时应用到工作球、日历和设置页。: Applies to the orb, calendar and settings.
日历顺序和每周工时一起调整。: Calendar columns and weekly totals follow this choice.
一圈的长度，由你来定。: Set the pace of your circle.
一天累计达到这个时长，日期外圈就会转满 360°。: Reach this daily total to complete the 360° ring.
修改目标会应用到所有月份的圆环和达标天数，已有工时保持原样。超过目标后，工时仍继: The goal updates rings and completed-day counts in every month. Recorded hours stay unchanged and keep counting beyond the goal.
在日历中点击日期，或点击「补录工时」，即可补充时长或修正当天累计。: Click a calendar date or Add time to add missing hours or correct a day's total.
工时留在本机，存放位置由你选择。: Your time stays on this computer, wherever you choose.
工时会自动保存到以下文件夹。: Work records are saved automatically in this folder.
更改位置会复制现有记录并立即使用新位置。原文件保留；请选择没有拾光工时记录的文件: Copies records and switches to the new folder. Original files stay in place. Choose a folder with no Shiguang records.
把所有日期的记录另存为一个备份文件。: Save a backup containing every recorded day.
按本机时间在零点分日。工作中锁屏和睡眠继续计时，临时离开不计时；正常退出会签退，: Days split at local midnight. While working, lock and sleep time count; breaks do not. Exiting clocks out an active session and preserves a paused state.
设置自动保存在本机: Settings are saved on this computer
Windows 已暂停此启动项。可以关闭后重新开启，或在 Windows 启动应: Windows has disabled this startup entry. Turn this switch off and on, or enable Shiguang in Windows Startup Apps.
目标可设为 1 分钟至 24 小时。: Choose a goal between 1 minute and 24 hours.
设置已保存，开机启动状态见上方提示: Settings saved. Check the startup notice above.
数据已复制到新位置，原文件已保留: Data copied to the new folder; originals kept
每周起始日已保存: First day of the week saved
让每一份认真，都有迹可循。: A little record of every effort.
关闭日历，保留工作球: Close calendar and keep the orb
认真工作的每一秒，都会长成一圈小小的绿意。: Every focused second grows a little circle of green.
今日正在计时，当日最多累计 24 小时，次日继续计时。: Today's timer is running. Each day is capped at 24 hours; counting continues on the next day.
工时已暂停，慢慢来。: Time is paused. Take your time.
休息也很重要，选一个吧。: Rest matters too. What suits you?
今日 {time} · 单击操作 · 双击日历 · 拖动贴边: Today {time} · Click for actions · Double-click for calendar · Drag to an edge
在这里陪你 · 点击展开 · 拖出恢复: Peeking here · Click to expand · Drag to bring me back
{day}开始 · 点击日期可补录: {day} first · Click a date to edit
把漏记的认真，补回来。: Give those missing hours a home.
今日正在计时，保存后仍会继续累加。: Today's timer is running and will keep counting after saving.
让工作球回到主屏幕: Move orb to the main display
操作未完成，请重试。: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
请为导出备份选择其他文件名，避免覆盖正在使用的工时或设置文件。: Choose another backup filename to avoid overwriting your current records or settings.
工时暂未保存，请检查磁盘空间或写入权限。: Work time could not be saved. Check disk space and write permissions.
修复后可再次退出。记录位置：: Fix the issue before quitting. Records:
无法更新开机启动项，请检查当前账户的写入权限。: Cannot update startup. Check write permissions for this Windows account.
未找到已迁移的工时记录，请连接数据磁盘或恢复文件：: Moved records are unavailable. Connect the data drive or restore this file:
工时记录无法读取，请保留此文件以便恢复：: Cannot read work records. Keep this file for recovery:
设置文件无法读取。为保留数据存储位置，请先恢复此文件：: Cannot read settings. Restore this file to preserve your data location:
请检查设置：圆环目标须为 1 分钟至 24 小时。: Check your settings. The ring goal must be between 1 minute and 24 hours.
该文件夹已有工时记录，请选择一个新的文件夹，避免覆盖已有数据。: This folder already contains work records. Choose an empty folder to avoid overwriting them.
不能补录未来日期的工时: Cannot add work to a future date
请选择补充时长或修正总时长: Choose Add duration or Set total
请输入 0 至 24 小时之间的有效时长: Enter a valid duration between 0 and 24 hours
补录后的当日总工时不能超过 24 小时: A corrected daily total cannot exceed 24 hours
请先签到再暂停: Clock in before taking a break
这一天还没有操作记录。: There are no events recorded for this day.
这一天没有已记录的在岗或休息时段。: There are no work or break intervals recorded for this day.
旧版记录或手动补录只保留总时长；未记录的历史节点无法还原。: Older records and manually added time preserve totals only; past events that were never recorded cannot be reconstructed.
手动调整会改变累计工时，但不会改写实际在岗与休息时段。: Manual adjustments change the total without changing recorded work and break intervals.
关机 / 重启 / 注销时自动下班: Automatically clocked out on shutdown, restart or sign-out
退出程序时自动下班: Automatically clocked out on application exit
异常中断，按最后保存时间下班: Interrupted session closed at the last saved time
旧版仅保留总时长，此处开始记录明细: Earlier versions stored totals only; detailed recording starts here
导出备份时结束记录: Record closed when the backup was exported
{day}开始 · 点击日期看记录: {day} first · Click a date for records
周一开始 · 点击日期看记录: Monday first · Click a date for records
按本机时间在零点分日。工作中锁屏和睡眠继续计时，临时离开不计时。退出时可选择继续: Days split at local midnight. Lock and sleep time count while working; breaks do not. Choose to keep timing on exit to add time away (including shutdown time) when you reopen the app. While the app is running, shutdown, restart or sign-out clocks you out. An interrupted session ends at the last saved time.
在日历中点击日期查看记录，再点击「补录工时」，即可补充时长或修正当天累计。: Click a calendar date to view its records, then choose Add time to add missing hours or correct the day's total.
在其他应用中，也能用快捷键控制拾光。: Control Shiguang with shortcuts while using other apps.
点击按键框录入组合键，保存后立即生效。: Click a key field to record a shortcut, then save to apply it immediately.
快捷键尚未保存，请先解决冲突。: Shortcuts are not saved. Resolve the conflicts first.
快捷键检查失败，请重试。: Could not check shortcuts. Please try again.
快捷键未保存，原设置仍然生效。: Shortcuts were not saved. Previous settings remain active.
请使用 Ctrl 或 Alt 加其他按键，或单独使用 F1–F24。: Use Ctrl or Alt with another key, or F1–F24 on its own.
不支持 Windows 键，请使用 Ctrl 或 Alt 组合。: The Windows key is not supported. Use a Ctrl or Alt combination.
不支持此按键，请尝试字母、数字、方向键或 F1–F24。: This key is not supported. Try a letter, number, arrow key or F1–F24.
支持 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 与字母、数字或导航键组合，也可单独使用 F1: Use Ctrl, Alt and Shift with letters, numbers or navigation keys, or F1–F24 on its own. Clear a field to disable that action.
默认不设置快捷键。拾光会自动检查重复设置和系统占用；系统保留组合键无法使用。: Shortcuts are unset by default. Shiguang checks for duplicates and unavailable combinations; shortcuts reserved by the system cannot be used.
组合键无效，请使用 Ctrl 或 Alt 搭配按键，或使用功能键。: Invalid shortcut. Use Ctrl or Alt with another key, or a function key.
此快捷键与其他操作重复。: This shortcut is already assigned to another action.
此组合键由系统保留，请选择其他快捷键。: This shortcut is reserved by the system. Choose another combination.
快捷键被其他程序占用或系统不允许注册，请更换组合键。: This shortcut is in use by another app or cannot be registered with the system. Choose another combination.
录入期间快捷键已暂停。: Shortcuts are paused while recording a key combination.
快捷键未保存，请处理冲突后重试。: Shortcuts were not saved. Resolve the conflicts and try again.
快捷键格式无效，请使用 Ctrl / Alt 与按键的组合，或 F1–F24。: Invalid shortcut. Use Ctrl or Alt with another key, or F1–F24.
同一个快捷键不能分配给多个操作。: A shortcut cannot be assigned to more than one action.
此快捷键由 Windows 系统保留，请选择其他组合。: This shortcut is reserved by Windows. Choose another combination.
快捷键无法注册，可能已被系统或其他应用占用。: This shortcut cannot be registered. It may be reserved by the system or in use by another app.
保存快捷键的回调必须是同步函数。: The shortcut save callback must be synchronous.
退出后，还要继续记录工时吗？: Keep recording work time after exit?
当前已暂停，退出后要开始计时吗？: You are paused. Start timing after exit?
继续计时：程序会完全退出，下次打开时补计离开期间的工时（包括关机时间）。\n停止:
Keep timing: the app will close completely and add time away when reopened, including time while the computer is shut down.
Stop timing: record work up to now and keep all existing records.
继续计时：从现在开始计时，程序会完全退出，下次打开时补计期间的工时（包括关机时间:
Keep timing: start timing now, close the app completely, and add time away when reopened, including shutdown time.
Stay paused: do not count time away and reopen paused. All existing work time is kept.
退出时选择继续计时: Chose to resume timing on exit
